```python
def test_largest_prime_factor():
    # Standard cases
    assert largest_prime_factor(13195) == 29  # 13195 = 5 * 7 * 13 * 29
    assert largest_prime_factor(2048) == 2    # 2048 = 2^11
    assert largest_prime_factor(15) == 5      # 15 = 3 * 5
    assert largest_prime_factor(27) == 3      # 27 = 3^3
    assert largest_prime_factor(63) == 7      # 63 = 3^2 * 7
    assert largest_prime_factor(100) == 5     # 100 = 2^2 * 5^2

    # Prime input: largest prime factor is itself
    assert largest_prime_factor(2) == 2
    assert largest_prime_factor(7) == 7
    assert largest_prime_factor(13) == 13
    assert largest_prime_factor(97) == 97

    # Edge case: n = 1 has no prime factors, function returns initial value
    assert largest_prime_factor(1) == 1

    # Larger composite number
    assert largest_prime_factor(600851475143) == 6857
```
